title: Vintage Seiko Bikoh Mini Slide Projector Viewer, 35mm 2x2 Japan - Untested
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Film Photography:Slide & Movie Projection:Slide Projectors
conditionDescription: Shows cosmetic wear consistent with age (scuffs, light corrosion on plug prongs). Sold as-is; untested electrically -- lamp/function not verified. No slide case included.
descriptionText:
Vintage Seiko Bikoh handheld slide projector/viewer for 35mm (2x2) slides. Compact all-metal body with focusing lens, top eyepiece for direct viewing, slide insertion slot, and attached AC power cord (117V, 6V/18W lamp -- spec plate shown in photos). Made in Japan.

Condition: shows cosmetic wear consistent with age (scuffs, light corrosion on plug prongs) -- see photos. Sold as-is; untested electrically -- lamp/function not verified. No slide case included.
